blocks.text: 🪝 Private Banks Lead FCNR(B) Deposit Drive; ICICI, HSBC & SBI Top Performers. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Forex swap windows incentivize private and foreign banks to mobilize non-resident foreign currency deposits.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
Private banks led FCNR(B) mobilization under RBI's limited-period USD-INR forex swap window.
Foreign banks led by **HSBC and Standard Chartered** mobilized nearly the same volume as all 12 PSBs combined.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**>$1B Private Banks:** 4 lenders (**ICICI, Kotak, Axis, HDFC**).
**>$1B PSBs:** Only 2 lenders (**SBI and Bank of Baroda**).
PSBs crossing $1B mark (only 2: SBI & BoB) vs Private banks (4: ICICI, Kotak, Axis, HDFC).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
